title: Zesty Peppery Irish Anchovy Pie
description: A peppery and adventurous Irish dish featuring anchovy fillet in a flaky en-croute pastry, perfect for a plant-based friendly dinner option.

ingredients.name: Anchovy fillets
ingredients.notes: canned in oil, drained and chopped

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, ground peppercorns, and salt.
Add the chilled vegan butter to the bowl and use a pastry blender to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the oat milk to the bowl, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and roll it out into a large circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
In a small bowl, mix together the chopped anchovy fillets, nutritional yeast, lemon juice, and chopped parsley.
Spoon the anchovy mixture onto one half of the dough circle, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the dough with the vegan egg replacement mixture.
Fold the other half of the dough circle over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Use a sharp knife to cut a few slits in the top of the pie to allow steam to escape.
Place the pie on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
